verses.en: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.sm: Amene. O le aioi atu a Paulo i le ekalesia ia lelei a latou amio Atua, ia outou tuuina atu o outou tino i le Atua, o le taulaga ola, ma le paia, ma le malie, o le mea lea e tatau ai ona outou faia.

verses.en: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.sm: Aua foi tou te amio faatasi ma lenei lalolagi, a e peitai ia liliuina i le toe fuataiina o outou loto, ina ia outou suesue pe se a le finagalo o le Atua, o mea ua lelei, ma le malie, ma le atoatoa.

verses.en: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
verses.sm: Aua o le alofa tunoa ua tuuina mai ai ia te au, ou te fai atu ai ia te outou uma, aua le faasili le manatu o se tasi i le mea ua tatau ona manatu ai, a ia mama le manatu, ia tusa ma le tofiga o le faatuatua ua taitasi ma tofu ai mai le Atua.

verses.en: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.sm: Aua faapei o itu tino e tele i le tino e tasi, a e le tasi se faiva i itu tino uma;

verses.en: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
verses.sm: E faapea i tatou nei le toatele, ua tino e tasi ia Keriso, ma ua fefaafeagaiai itu tino.

verses.en: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
verses.sm: O loo eseese foi a tatou mea e tufaina mai i le alofa tunoa ua foaiina mai ia te i tatou; po o le perofeta, ia faatatauina ma le tofi o le faatuatua;

verses.en: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
verses.sm: po o le tiakono, ia faia le faiva o le tiakono; po o le a'oa'o, ia a'oa'o atu ia;

verses.en: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.sm: po o le apoapoal, ia apoapoai O ia; o le foai mea ia faia ma le matamau; o lé pule, ia faia ma le filiga; o le fai mea alofa, ia faia ma le loto fiafia.

verses.en: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi faatagā alofa; ia ‘ino‘ino i le leaga, ia pipii i le lelei.

verses.en: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
verses.sm: to Ja fefaapelepeleai i le fealofani o uso; ia tausolomua ona ava o le tasi i le tasi.

verses.en: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.sm: Aua le faavaivai i le filigā, ia malosi le loto, ia auauna i le Alii.

verses.en: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.sm: Ia olioli i le faamoemoe, ia onosai i le puapuaga, ia finafinau i le tatalo.

verses.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.sm: Ia tufatufa atu ni a outou mea i le mativa o le au peia, ia tausisi i le alofa i tagata ese.

verses.en: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.sm: Ia faamanuia atu i e faasaua mai ia te outou, ia faamanuia lava, a e aua le fetuu.

verses.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.sm: la outou olioli faatasi ma e ua olioli, ia outou tagi foi faatasi ma e ua fetagisi.

verses.en: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.sm: Ia gatasitasi o outou manatu; aua le manatu i mea silisili, a ia feoai ma e ua faamaulalo; aua le faafiapopoto.

verses.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.sm: Aua le taui atu le leaga i le leaga i se tasi; ia sauniuni mea e tusa i luma o tagata uma lava.

verses.en: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.sm: Afai e mafaia ia te outou, ia outou nofo lelei ma tagata uma lava.

verses.en: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Le au pele e, aua le taui atu ma sui, a ia outou tuu atu i le toasa; aua ua tusia, Ua faapea mai le Alii, O za te au le taui ma sui, ou te taui atu.

verses.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.sm: O lenei, a matelaina le ua ita mat ta te oe, fafaga ia te ia; a fia inu ia, avatu ta te ta e inu ais auã o le amio faapea e faafaupue ai malala ola i luga i lona ulu.

verses.en: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.sm: Aua le faatoilaloina oe i le leaga, a ia e faatoilaloina le leaga i le lelei.
